written.headline: Harvard study estimates power use of 403 US hyperscale data centers
written.summary: A new study published in Nature Sustainability reveals that 403 U.S. hyperscale data centers consumed around 82 terawatt-hours of electricity between May 2024 and April 2025. Researchers used satellite imagery to estimate facility-level power consumption, finding that these large centers are powered mostly by fossil fuels.

written.headline: India and nine nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains
written.summary: India and nine other nations signed the San Francisco Declaration on the Secure Foundations of Enduring Prosperity to protect AI infrastructure and sensitive technologies. The agreement was signed on November 15 at the Pax Silica retreat.

written.headline: Nvidia faces third-quarter earnings call under interim CEO Colette Kress
written.summary: Nvidia reports its third-quarter results with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO following the resignation of founder Jensen Huang. The company faces congressional inquiries and questions regarding chip sales to China and export restrictions.

written.headline: Anthropic prices its IPO on Wednesday with valuation up to $1.4 trillion
written.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering price is expected Wednesday evening, valuing the company at up to $1.4 trillion. Buyers have requested an order volume nearly seven times the shares being offered, with trading set to start Thursday on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.

written.headline: Ethan Mollick on computer infrastructure and offensive AI threats
written.summary: Ethan Mollick noted that computer infrastructure is an improvised system vulnerable to cascading failures and outlined the arrival of offensive AI threats alongside defensive AIs and patching.
